output_units.mu_hat_horizon: expected return over horizon (daily_log_return scale summed)
output_units.mu_raw_score: raw CNN output prior to calibration (unitless score)

selection_rationale: Chosen from ensemble_search_with_cnnlstm.csv as the best combination by OOS rank correlation under rank aggregation. The selected members are logistic_image_scale and cnnlstm_image_scale. This combination achieved OOS rank correlation of 0.0552 and top-k Sharpe of 0.4412. CNNLSTM is added as a separate sequential-image model family, distinct from the existing cnn_lstm_image_scale result.
